pages.title: Coalification
pages.text: Coalification refers to the process where the biome turns darker and has a negligible cognitohazard effect, where anyone inside will see the sky as dark and red. Additionally, Risus Wisps will regularly appear, which are completely harmless and simply an observable version of the souls/minds present within the Risus. They can also be found congregating within Depth Vases.
The Coalification can be forcefully spread by amassing Remains, Organic Matter and Bone Meal. Since usual monsters don't appear in it, living in land covered by Coalification can be preferred.
